data.name: Query_BusinessPartnerGLDetail
data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments ,CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--{9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From Sal_InvoiceHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' {0} {5} {6} {12}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union All ---------- Purchase Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as CustomerAccountCode , Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From AR_InvoiceHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionHeader On AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail On AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' {0} {5} {6} {12}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
Union All
---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select DISTINCT GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and PBD.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status=1 --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' ANd GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1
--Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Receipt against sale%' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%OPENING%' AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {0} {5} {6} {11} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber Union All
---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail only receipt sale invocie ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select DISTINCT GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and PBD.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status=1 --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' ANd GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1
--Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Receipt against sale%' AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {0} {5} {6} {11} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all ---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail - Opening ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select DISTINCT AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID

data.value:
select * ,isnull((select top 1 CustomerCategory from Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID = Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = fintab.CustomerID ),'NIll') as CustomerCategory from ( select distinct LastTab.CompanyID, LastTab.CustomerID, LastTab.EmployeeCode, LastTab.CustomerName, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)) as ActivityCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) as ActivityDebit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) as OpeningCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) as OpeningDebit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)) ClosingCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) ClosingDebit, ISNULL(case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull (LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) < 0 then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)), 1)) when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) > 0 then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit,0)), 1)) end ,0) as ClosingAmount, case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) < 0 then 'Credit' when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) > 0 then 'Debit' end as ClosingAmountType --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as BusinessPartnerTypeCode @WithConsolidated @WithType
,(Select Description from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID ) as CodeDescription , 'NOTChecked' as OrderBy inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID
AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in (SELECT distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType like 'Advance Against PO%') AND (CompanyID in @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID))) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit')

WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate and isnull(GL_TransactionDetail .Narration,'') like '%GST%' and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%GST%' AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {0} {1} ) as tab

---------- Purchase Return ---------- Select distinct FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Debit), 'Debit' as CrDr From ( Select distinct AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumber ,STUFF(( select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10),INV_StockTransactionheader.DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionheader on INV_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceDetail invDtl on invDtl.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and invDtl.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and invDtl.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and invDtl.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and invDtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and invDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS GRN_NO ,STUFF(( Select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10), AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1 {2} INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {1} {0} {5}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName

GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumber ,STUFF(( select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10),INV_StockTransactionheader.DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionheader on INV_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceDetail invDtl on invDtl.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and invDtl.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and invDtl.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and invDtl.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and invDtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and invDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS GRN_NO ,STUFF(( Select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10), AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1 {2} INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) {1} {0} {5}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName
-----------End Purchase return
UNION ALL ----Sales Invoice Return Select distinct FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Credit), 'Credit' as CrDr From ( SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO , AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Local Sale Debtor - Sugar' left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID WHERE SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1} {0}
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.ContactNumber , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPerson , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo ,SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ,GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName
union all
Select distinct importtab.CustomerID, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(importtab.Amount), 'Credit' as CrDr from ( ---------Import Document --------------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POheaderID as SourceID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'International Vendor'
WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%import%' {0} {1}
) as importtab group by importtab.CustomerID, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName
) tab
group by tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.CrDr, tab.BusinessPartnerName
)outerTab
group by OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.CustomerName, outertab.Type,outerTab.BusinessPartnerName
) as LastTab inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = LastTab.BusinessPartnerName inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = LastTab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = LastTab.CompanyID
group by LastTab.CustomerID,LastTab.EmployeeCode,LastTab.CustomerName, LastTab.companyID --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID @WithGroup @ConsolidatedGroup )as fintab
@WithOrderByGL

data.name: Query_BusinesspartnerTrialBalanceMonthWise

With mycte as ( select * ,isnull((select top 1 CustomerCategory from Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID = Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = fintab.CustomerID ),'NIll') as CustomerCategory ,case when ClosingAmount < 0 then ClosingAmount else 0 end as ClosingCredit ,case when ClosingAmount > 0 then ClosingAmount else 0 end as ClosingDebit from ( select distinct LastTab.CompanyID, LastTab.CustomerID, LastTab.EmployeeCode, LastTab.CustomerName --, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)) as ActivityCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) as ActivityDebit, -- sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) as OpeningCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) as OpeningDebit, -- (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))* -1 ClosingCredit, -- sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) ClosingDebit, -- ISNULL(case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull (LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - -- (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) < 0 -- then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + -- sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)), 1)) -- when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + -- sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) > 0 -- then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + -- sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit,0)), 1)) end ,0) as ClosingAmounts, ,case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) < 0 then 'Credit' when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) > 0 then 'Debit' end as ClosingAmountType --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as BusinessPartnerTypeCode @WithConsolidated @WithType
,(Select Description from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID ) as CodeDescription , 'NOTChecked' as OrderBy ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years,Type,CrDr , case when Type = 'Activity' then SUM(ISNULL(ActivityDebit,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(ActivityCredit,0)) when Type = 'Opening' then SUM(ISNULL(OpeningDebit,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(OpeningCredit,0))
end as ClosingAmount from ( select (Select companyID from AR_SET_Customer as tbl_Customer where tbl_Customer.Status = 1 and tbl_Customer.CustomerID = OuterTab.CustomerID) as CompanyID , OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.CustomerName, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.BusinessPartnerName, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as ActivityCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as ActivityDebit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as OpeningCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as OpeningDebit ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years ,outertab.Type,CrDr from ( select tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.BusinessPartnerName, case when tab.CrDr = 'Credit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end CreditAmount, case when tab.CrDr = 'Debit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end DebitAmount, 'Opening' as Type , 'Opening' as MonthNames, '1' MonthNum, '1' as Years,null as crdr from ( select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {0} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all ---------- DI-Customer ---------- select distinct AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID inner join sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 {0} {1} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {0} {4} and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Credit' as CrDr from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like 'Customer'
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0} {4} and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {4} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0} and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
------------ Payment (Debit) (Payment Vendor Invoice) ----------
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum(isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail .PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration,'') = 'GST' ),0) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.periodID = AP_PaymentHeader.periodID {2}
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1

convert(varchar(10),INV_StockTransactionheader.DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionheader on INV_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO
, DATENAME(MONTH,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years

) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years
-----------End Purchase return
UNION ALL ----Sales Invoice Return Select distinct FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Credit), 'Credit' as CrDr ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years From ( SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO , AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName , DATENAME(MONTH,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate)),3,4) as Years FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Local Sale Debtor - Sugar' left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID WHERE SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1} {0}
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.ContactNumber , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPerson , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo ,SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ,GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years
union all
Select distinct importtab.CustomerID, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(importtab.Amount), 'Credit' as CrDr ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years from ( ---------Import Document --------------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POheaderID as SourceID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO , DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years
FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'International Vendor'
WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%import%' {0} {1}
) as importtab group by importtab.CustomerID, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years
) tab
group by tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.CrDr, tab.BusinessPartnerName ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years
)outerTab
group by OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.CustomerName, outertab.Type,outerTab.BusinessPartnerName,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years ,CrDr
) as LastTab inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = LastTab.BusinessPartnerName inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = LastTab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = LastTab.CompanyID
group by LastTab.CustomerID,LastTab.EmployeeCode,LastTab.CustomerName, LastTab.companyID,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years,Type,CrDr --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID @WithGroup @ConsolidatedGroup )as fintab )
select * from mycte
union all
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,'',cte.BusinessPartnerTypeCode,cte.BusinessPartnerName,CodeDescription,Orderby, DATENAME(MONTH,Set_DateTime.theDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(Set_DateTime.theDate)),3,4) ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,Set_DateTime.theDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(Set_DateTime.theDate)),3,4) as Years,'Activity','Debit' , 0 ,'NA',0,0 from AR_SET_Customer
INNER JOIN ( SELECT top 1 * FROM mycte --WHERE RowNum = 1 ) cte ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = cte.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = cte.CompanyID
--inner join cte on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = cte.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = cte.CompanyID inner join Set_DateTime on Convert(date,Set_DateTime.theDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate
where AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID
union all
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,'',cte.BusinessPartnerTypeCode,cte.BusinessPartnerName,CodeDescription,Orderby, DATENAME(MONTH,Set_DateTime.theDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(Set_DateTime.theDate)),3,4) ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,Set_DateTime.theDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(Set_DateTime.theDate)),3,4) as Years,'Activity','Credit' , 0 ,'NA',0,0 from AR_SET_Customer
INNER JOIN ( SELECT top 1 * FROM mycte --WHERE RowNum = 1 ) cte ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = cte.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = cte.CompanyID
--inner join cte on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = cte.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = cte.CompanyID inner join Set_DateTime on Convert(date,Set_DateTime.theDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate
where AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID
--@WithOrderByGL
